low.title: ✅ PREECLAMPSIA RISK: LOW
low.message: Your assessment shows minimal indicators for preeclampsia. Continue routine prenatal care.

moderate.title: ⚠️ PREECLAMPSIA RISK: MODERATE

high.title: 🚨 HIGH RISK: PREECLAMPSIA DETECTED
high.message: Your profile shows strong indicators for preeclampsia. Immediate medical attention recommended.
high.explanation: Preeclampsia is a serious condition that affects blood pressure and organ function. Early detection and management are crucial for safe outcomes.
immediate_actions: Consider getting a home blood pressure monitor
Watch for symptoms: severe headaches, vision changes, upper abdominal pain, swelling
